# Sirach Chapter 23 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 23 | **Date:** 2026-03-17

---

**23:1** LORD, Father and Master of my life — don't hand me over to what my mouth would do; don't let it bring me down.

**23:2** I wish someone would discipline my thoughts the way a taskmaster disciplines a worker — not letting my ignorant mistakes pile up, not letting my sins slip by.

**23:3** Otherwise my failures will multiply and my sins will overflow, and I'll go down in the eyes of my enemies while they stand there cheering.

**23:4** LORD, Father and God of my life — don't let pride take hold in my eyes; take lust far away from me.

**23:5** Don't let appetite and sexual craving get their hooks in me; don't hand me over to a brazen spirit.

**23:6** Children, listen carefully to how you use your mouth. Those who keep this discipline won't be caught in its trap.

**23:7** The sinner is snared by his own words; the proud and the blasphemer both stumble right into them.

**23:8** Don't let oath-swearing become second nature to you; don't get into the habit of mentioning God's holy name.

**23:9** A servant who gets interrogated all the time never escapes being bruised; in the same way, someone who swears constantly and invokes the Name will never be free of sin.

**23:10** Swear all the time and you'll be swimming in wrongdoing; the scourge won't leave your house. If you slip up, the sin sticks to you; if you brush it off, you've doubled it; if the oath was empty, you won't be acquitted — and your house will fill up with trouble.

**23:11** There is a way of speaking that is wrapped in death. God forbid it should be found among the people of Jacob. Those who are faithful to God keep clear of all this — they won't roll around in sins.

**23:12** Don't train yourself to use crude language — there's sin wrapped up in every bit of it.

**23:13** Think about your father and mother — you're in the company of important people. Don't lose yourself in front of them; don't let bad habits turn you into a fool, and make you wish you'd never been born and curse the day you came into the world.

**23:14** People who make a habit of abusive speech can never be corrected.

**23:15** Two kinds of people pile sin on sin, and a third draws down God's anger: a soul burning like fire that won't be put out until it's consumed everything; a man addicted to sexual sin who won't stop until the fire burns itself out.

**23:16** Everything is sweet to the sexually addicted person — they won't get tired of it until they die.

**23:17** The man who cheats on his wife tells himself: "Who's watching? It's dark, the walls hide me, nobody can see. What have I got to be scared of? The Most High won't even remember my sins."

**23:18** He's only thinking about human eyes. What he doesn't think about is that God's eyes are ten thousand times brighter than the sun — watching every path a person walks, piercing every hidden place.

**23:19** Everything was known before it was made; everything is known after it's done.

**23:20** This man will be caught out in the open streets of the city, and seized where he least expected it.

**23:21** The same goes for the woman who left her husband and produced a child by a stranger.

**23:22** First, she defied the law of the Most High. Second, she betrayed her husband. Third, she committed adultery and brought children into the world by another man.

**23:23** She will be dragged before the public assembly, and her children will face judgment.

**23:24** Her children will never put down roots; her branches will bear no fruit.

**23:25** Her memory will be left as a byword for shame, and her disgrace will never be wiped away.

**23:26** Those who survive will recognize it: nothing is better than fearing the LORD, nothing sweeter than obeying his commandments.

**23:27** Following the LORD is the greatest honor there is; he gives long life to those who do.

**23:28** Whoever lives this way will inherit praise, for the fear of the LORD is life itself — it lets you sleep through the night undisturbed.
